risk_if_not_implemented: Without Non-Persistent Information, sensitive information may be inadvertently exposed through error messages, insecure code, or persistent ephemeral data.

compensating_control_1.name: System Media Sanitization
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to sanitize system media with the strength and integrity commensurate with the classification or sensitivity of the information prior to disposal, release out of organizational control or release for reuse.
compensating_control_1.justification: System Media Sanitization (DCH-09) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Non-Persistent Information (SEA-08.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Session Termination
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to log out users, both locally on the network and for remote sessions, at the end of the session or after an organization-defined period of inactivity.
compensating_control_2.justification: Session Termination (IAC-25) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Non-Persistent Information (SEA-08.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
